description: Free. Answers: which Orb Studio sensors can I rely on right now? The answer block lists use_now, check_age_first and do_not_rely_on. For every sensor: the time the source's data refers to, its age in hours, the age that is normal for that source (update interval plus usual publication delay) and a status: on_time, late, stale, unknown (the source does not say when it measured), no_data, or event (event feeds and manual input). Read numbers together with their age: a live price, a daily gas day and a yearly crime statistic describe different moments. Timeliness only, not accuracy.
name: get_freshness
title: Reality lag map: how fresh every Orb Studio sensor is
